mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 3% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressure, which typically leads to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) for three consecutive months indicates a weakening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of the instances where HOUST declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening supply-side activity, which is bullish for the S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increases > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening of monetary policy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances where FEDFUNDS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and the nonfarm payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 200,000, it indicates a tight labor market and strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS increases > 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real final sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which is a positive signal for the S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where RSAFS increases > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is above its 12-month moving average and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 3%, it indicates a favorable environment for corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO > 12-month MA and FEDFUNDS < 3%.
